spec.requirement: The exported plan produces one canonical board row per task, carrying the task's acceptance criteria verbatim and the plan digest the approval bound.
spec.verification: Inspection here on purpose: a runnable example must not name a test file the consuming repository does not track. Replace this block with method="test" runner="pytest" path="tests/<your file>.py" selector="<your test>" once the real test exists.
spec.requirement: Batch export of several plans in one run, and the judge-handoff dispatch leg, are a later wave's work — the exclusion below keeps them visible and explained.
spec.acceptance: The canonical row's acceptance-criteria text equals this block's body exactly; a drifted row is repaired through `boardctl update`, never left behind.
spec.task: Export this plan's one task as one canonical board row, with the acceptance criteria embedded verbatim and the ch:trace marker binding row, spec blocks, test obligation and witness.
